description: Bond valence sum, coordination composition, occupancy and B-factor comparison of the Zn, Ca and Na sites in LysK CHAPK (4CSH)
code:
import requests, os, json, math
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
CACHE="/tmp/pdbcache"; os.makedirs(CACHE,exist_ok=True)
def get_pdb(pid):
    p=os.path.join(CACHE,pid+".pdb")
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        r=S.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb",timeout=180); r.raise_for_status(); open(p,"w").write(r.text)
    return open(p).read()
def parse(txt):
    rows=[]
    for l in txt.splitlines():
        if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            try: xyz=[float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]
            except ValueError: continue
            rows.append(dict(rec=l[:6].strip(),name=l[12:16].strip(),res=l[17:20].strip(),ch=l[21],seq=int(l[22:26]),
                             x=xyz[0],y=xyz[1],z=xyz[2],occ=float(l[54:60] or 1),b=float(l[60:66] or 0),
                             el=(l[76:78].strip() or l[12:14].strip())))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

A=parse(get_pdb("4CSH")); X=A[["x","y","z"]].to_numpy()
# Bond valence parameters (Brown & Altermatt / CheckMyMetal), b = 0.37
R0={("ZN","O"):1.704,("ZN","S"):2.090,("ZN","N"):1.759,
    ("CA","O"):1.967,("CA","N"):2.140,
    ("NA","O"):1.803,("NA","N"):1.890}
def bvs(i, cutoff=3.2):
    ion=A.iloc[i].res
    d=np.linalg.norm(X-X[i],axis=1)
    sel=np.where((d<cutoff)&(d>0.1))[0]
    tot=0.0; lig=[]
    for j in sel:
        e=A.iloc[j].el
        if (ion,e) not in R0: continue
        v=math.exp((R0[(ion,e)]-d[j])/0.37); tot+=v
        lig.append((f"{A.iloc[j].res}{A.iloc[j].seq}:{A.iloc[j]['name']}", round(float(d[j]),2), round(v,3)))
    return tot, lig

rows=[]
for i in A.index[(A.rec=="HETATM")&(A.res.isin(["ZN","CA","NA"]))]:
    k=A.index.get_loc(i); r=A.loc[i]
    v,lig=bvs(k)
    prot_lig=[x for x in lig if not x[0].startswith("HOH")]
    rows.append(dict(ion=r.res,chain=r.ch,occ=r.occ,B=r.b,n_total_lig=len(lig),n_protein_lig=len(prot_lig),
                     n_water_lig=len(lig)-len(prot_lig),BVS=round(v,2),
                     expected_valence={"ZN":2,"CA":2,"NA":1}[r.res],
                     protein_ligands="; ".join(f"{a}@{b}" for a,b,_ in prot_lig)))
BV=pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width",260); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",95)
print(BV.to_string(index=False))
print("\nMeans by ion:")
print(BV.groupby("ion")[["occ","B","n_protein_lig","n_water_lig","BVS"]].mean().round(2).to_string())

# ---- FIGURE ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,4,figsize=(17,4.4))
grp=BV.groupby("ion")
order=["CA","ZN","NA"]; labels=["Ca2+ site\n(N-lobe loop)","Zn2+ site\n(on Cys54 S)","Na+ site\n(surface)"]
col=["#2E7D32","#C62828","#9E9E9E"]

ax=axes[0]
pl=[grp.get_group(o).n_protein_lig.mean() for o in order]
wl=[grp.get_group(o).n_water_lig.mean() for o in order]
ax.bar(labels,pl,color=col,label="protein ligands")
ax.bar(labels,wl,bottom=pl,color=col,alpha=0.35,label="water ligands")
ax.set_ylabel("ligands within 3.2 A"); ax.set_title("Coordination sphere composition"); ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=8)
for i,(p,w) in enumerate(zip(pl,wl)): ax.text(i,p/2,f"{p:.0f}",ha="center",color="w",fontweight="bold")

ax=axes[1]
bv=[grp.get_group(o).BVS.mean() for o in order]
er=[grp.get_group(o).BVS.std() for o in order]
ax.bar(labels,bv,yerr=er,color=col,capsize=4)
ax.axhline(2.0,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax.text(2.35,2.03,"expected 2.0\n(Zn2+, Ca2+)",fontsize=8,ha="right")
ax.axhline(1.0,ls=":",c="k",lw=1); ax.text(2.35,1.03,"expected 1.0 (Na+)",fontsize=8,ha="right")
ax.set_ylabel("bond valence sum"); ax.set_title("Bond valence of modelled ions (4CSH)")

ax=axes[2]
x=np.arange(3)
ax.bar(x-0.2,[grp.get_group(o).occ.mean() for o in order],0.4,color=col,label="occupancy")
ax2=ax.twinx()
ax2.bar(x+0.2,[grp.get_group(o).B.mean() for o in order],0.4,color=col,alpha=0.4,hatch="//",label="B-factor")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=8); ax.set_ylabel("refined occupancy"); ax2.set_ylabel("B-factor (A^2)")
ax.set_ylim(0,1.15); ax.set_title("Occupancy (solid) and B-factor (hatched)")

ax=axes[3]
d={"Zn - Cys54 SG":2.22,"Zn - His117 ND1":4.23,"Zn - Glu134 OE1":8.92,"Ca - Cys54 SG":9.75,"Ca - Zn":9.98}
ax.barh(list(d.keys())[::-1],list(d.values())[::-1],color=["#2E7D32","#2E7D32","#C62828","#C62828","#C62828"][::-1])
ax.axvline(2.6,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax.text(2.7,4.2,"inner-sphere limit",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("distance (A), mean of 4 chains"); ax.set_title("Metal to catalytic-triad distances")
plt.suptitle("LysK CHAP$_K$ (PDB 4CSH): the Ca$^{2+}$ site is a complete structural site, the Zn$^{2+}$ is a partial-occupancy adduct on the catalytic thiolate",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
